g.title: You do not need to cut a table down to answer questions about it
g.desc: core lesson cabinet you do not need to cut a table down to answer questions about it
g.text: You don’t need to cut a table down to answer questions about it
Hard decomposition risks discarding the very cells that hold the answer.

g.title: Softly weight every cell by a learned relevance score, keeping full access to the data
g.desc: softly weighting every cell according to learned relevance score instead of hard-decomposing table risking loss of useful information model keeps full access to data steered toward what matters
g.text: Softly weight every cell by learned relevance
The model keeps full access to the whole table while being steered toward what matters.

g.title: Pairing a differentiable unsupervised relevance scorer with a weakly-supervised cell highlighter yields accuracy and robustness
g.desc: pairing differentiable unsupervised relevance scorer with weakly-supervised parsing-statement cell highlighter yields higher accuracy greater robustness to noise new state of the art three table QA benchmarks compact five hundred sixty million parameter model
g.text: More accurate and more robust than removal-based methods — new SoTA with a compact 560M model.
